dataset: RSICD Test Gallery (1,093 images, 5,465 human captions)

protocol_investigation.finding: Asymmetric Information Boundaries between Lexical and Multimodal Protocols
protocol_investigation.bm25_loco_leakage_mechanism: In RSICD, each image has 5 captions written by human annotators. In the Leave-One-Caption-Out (LOCO) BM25 protocol, the query caption is held out, but the 4 remaining human captions for that exact target image remain in the candidate text gallery. Because crowd-workers frequently repeat distinctive phrasing (e.g. 'many airplanes parked at terminal gates'), BM25 LOCO achieves R@1=42.12% through sibling caption lexical overlap.
protocol_investigation.bm25_metadata_control: When all human captions are removed from the gallery and only category metadata labels are indexed (e.g. 'airport', 'parking'), BM25 lexical recall drops sharply to R@1=1.50% (MRR=0.0618).
protocol_investigation.clip_cross_modal_integrity: CLIP ViT-B/32 operates under genuine cross-modal conditions where the candidate gallery contains zero human text (only 512-dimensional visual image embeddings). Query text is mapped directly into visual latent space, achieving R@1=5.45% (R@10=27.89%, MRR=0.1307) without text-text leakage.
protocol_investigation.prompt_ensemble_effect: Averaging 5 domain-specific remote sensing prompt templates yields R@1=5.14% and R@10=28.01% with 14.71 ms CPU latency (vs 7.46 ms single prompt), demonstrating template robustness at 1.97x compute cost.
protocol_investigation.missing_reranking_status: CLIP + Metadata Reranking does not exist in the repository codebase. Milestone M7 was designated and executed strictly as Learned Change Detection (FC-Siam-diff). The retrieval reranking feature remains unexecuted and is formally marked NOT IMPLEMENTED.
